messages:
sara: Quick postmortem follow-up. We keep seeing the same dependency classes: cloud control-plane rate bursts, auth-provider refresh storms, and model-registry throttles. Need owners + minimal sprint plan to reduce recurrence. Can people claim?
kevin: Ian take the control-plane work. Immediate fixes: aggressive exponential retry + region failover rules + rate-limit-aware backoff. Deliverable: updated runbook + deployable rollback play. ETA: 10 business days.
olivia: Ian own auth storms. Short-term: add jittered refresh, local TTL cache for tokens, and a graceful degraded-mode using secondary provider. Need securityonfirmation on KMS key rotation window.
josh: Ilaim model-registry throttles. Plan: artifact prefetch + bulk warmup pipeline + read-through cache. Also implement a read-only fallback that serves last-known-good artifacts. Timeline: 1 sprint + 2 days for canary.
ops-bot: Created issue INF-9021: "dependency-mitigation/sprint-epic" - owners can add sub-tasks. Due: 2027-02-01. Link: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-9021
mike: Please add measurable success criteria. Suggest per-class goals: reduce P99 latency spikes by >=40%, cut incident rate to <=1/month within 45 days of rollout, and 90% synthetic check pass rate. Also add a dashboard card for cost delta.
sara: Good. Owners: kevin (cloud control-plane), olivia (auth), josh (model-registry). Mike is backup and will own telemetry. Actions: 1) Add subtasks to INF-9021 with owners and estimates by EOD Thursday; 2) Add runbook sections: indicators, rollback, oncall contacts; 3) Schedule monthly fire-drills for each pattern.
kevin: Pushing initial fallback snippet to the issue:
```json
{
  "fallback_order": ["local-cache","registry-readonly","proxy-degrade"],
  "retries": {"attempts": 4, "backoff_ms": [200, 400, 800, 1600]},
  "circuit_breaker": {"error_threshold": 0.05, "window_ms": 60000, "open_ms": 300000}
}
```
josh: Canary plan: staging 15% -> prod 10% for first 6h -> 30% if stable at 24h. Add cron pre-warm at 03:30 UTC for hot models.
olivia: Vendor contact updated: support@authco.example. Requested SLA extract, burst thresholds, and escalation contacts. Also asked for test token endpoint for preflight.
mike: When adding caches/warms, track memory and egress changes. If cost impact >8% tag as "tradeoff-needed" in INF-9021.
sara: I'll schedule a 20m sync on Tue to confirm owners and unblock sec for KMS windows. If you've claimed an item, add yourself as assignee in INF-9021 and drop a 1-line plan in the issue today. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll add a short test harness that injects 2x token refresh rate and simulates 10% control-plane failures for validation.
ops-bot: Reminder: INF-9021 has checklist items assigned but no due-estimates on subtasks.
mike: Also propose adding regression alerting: when synthetic P99 increases >20% vs baseline for 3 consecutive runs, open P1 and auto-scale to dedicated pool if available.
sara: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after owners update INF-9021. Keep comments short and put non-urgent details in the issue.
